name: qlrisk_price_basis_swap
title: Price a BasisSwap
description:
Price one Basis Swap - floating vs floating with different indices (qlrisk BasisSwap).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, pay_index=SOFR, receive_index=SOFR, spread_bp=0, pay_frequency=quarterly, receive_frequency=quarterly, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 0.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
